core_question: Can the Run-93 certified infinite mRPI tail move an H15 q-exposed face back into the position measurement strip?
theorem: For S=S_N+T_N, every q-exposed point x=x_N+x_T satisfies |e_px^T x_T| <= r_px(N). With alpha=||F^M||_inf<1, r_px(N) <= D0*sum_{j=0}^{M-1}|e_px^T F^(N+j)G|/(1-alpha).
status: Tail lemma and tail bound are proof-quality; 160/160 infinite-face disjointness remains conditional on exact/interval certification of Run-104 finite exposed-face margins.
next_unique_priority: Exact or outward-rounded interval certification of all 160 finite H15 exposed-face px margins, especially q_plus/q_minus seeds.
